semantic_boundary.request_tokens: Opaque H1, H2, and subsequent request-local tokens
semantic_boundary.model_output: Polygons for supplied tokens or an explicit unlocated result

observations: Remap needs only geometry for existing hotspots, so destination selection and new-hotspot invention were removed from the model contract.
Opaque request-local tokens bind returned polygons to authoritative hotspot semantics without exposing persisted UUIDs.
Batches of four bound schema size while one document command applies the complete remap atomically.
Invalid, missing, duplicate, or unknown token output cannot replace authoritative geometry.
Out-of-range coordinates are clamped deterministically and reported as warnings.

model_recommendation: Use qwen3.5:9b-mlx for production remapping and retain the existing geometry whenever a supplied hotspot cannot be located safely.
